name: Steffen Nielsen
summary: Steffen Nielsen has 2 coaching stints at 1 club (41 league games) in the dataset, from 2009/10 to 2010/11. Too few games for a grade (the ranking requires at least 3 stints and 10 games). The best stint above squad-value expectation was Odense Boldklub 2009/10 (+0.11 PPG); the toughest was Odense Boldklub 2010/11 (-0.26 PPG).
